newsitem.title: UK: London tea auction sees steady to higher prices.
newsitem.headline: London tea auction sees steady to higher prices.

text.p: The London tea auction saw improved demand spread more widely across the origins, the official report said.
In the landed sector, brightest and coloury medium East Africans were up to two pence per kilo higher but brighter mediums lost two to three pence.
Ceylon types sold at generally higher prices, the report said.
An offshore offering of 400 packages Kenya tea and 600 Malawi met with firm to increased rates in good demand.
The next auction is on Monday, February 3rd.
